title: MMV
text: R-first toolkit automatic visualization water maze minefield trajectory tasks. MMV focuses : - unified CSV schema - explicit legacy--standard CSV conversion - two direct plotting functions - thisplot-style theme integration builtin fallback

title: MMV
text: Development-mode example script: Helper scripts: - inst/examples/example_usage.R: minimal end--end example. - scripts/run_examples.R: template conversion + watermaze + minefield + batch.
code: wm_csv <- system.file("templates", "watermaze_template.csv", package = "MMV") mf_csv <- system.file("templates", "minefield_template.csv", package = "MMV")  # 1) Convert to standard schema (recommended) cnv <- convert_mmviz_csv(   path = wm_csv,   out_path = "outputs/watermaze_template_standard.csv",   task = "watermaze",   overwrite = TRUE )  # 2) Water maze (line-gradient trajectory, non-gradient background) plot_watermaze(   cnv$output_file,   cfg = list(     style_mode = "thisplot",     plot_mode = "line_gradient",     out_file = "outputs/watermaze_demo.png"   ) )  # 3) Minefield (heatmap + optional trajectory overlay) plot_minefield(   mf_csv,   cfg = list(     style_mode = "thisplot",     overlay_trajectory = TRUE,     out_file = "outputs/minefield_demo.png"   ) ) source("inst/examples/example_usage.R")
